name: Attempt Sync
description: Sync Attempt Playback ghosts between devices using a private GitHub repository

repository.name: Repository
repository.description: Your private GitHub repository, as owner/repository. Initialize it with a README.

github-token.name: GitHub Token
github-token.description: Fine-grained personal access token for this repository only, with Contents read/write. Stored locally in Geode settings, in plain text. Never share your settings file.

auto-sync.name: Sync at Main Menu
auto-sync.description: After configuring GitHub, enable to sync whenever the main menu opens. Imports wait until gameplay ends.
